sim_assumptions.what: Published bars and box medians read off Figs 2 and 3 (the 2400 x 1200 images in the paper's PDF) through each panel's tick marks
sim_assumptions.sensitivity: Tick fits within 0.22 px; one power point is 3.82 px and every bar reads within 0.2 points of an integer count; Fig. 3 medians within 0.1 of a half-integer. The reading error is far below the Monte Carlo tolerance.

sim_assumptions.what: Disease models: Marchini et al.'s tables of odds for models 1 and 3; for model 2 the table of epiMODE (Tang et al. 2009, the same group), (1+t)^2, (1+t)^3, (1+t)^4 for two, three and four disease alleles, where Marchini has 1+t, (1+t)^2, (1+t)^4
sim_assumptions.sensitivity: Chosen among six documented readings by the exact chi-squared power, which involves no random forest (output/checks/model_variants.json): epiMODE's table puts 21 of the 24 chi-squared bars within Monte Carlo error (8 of 8 in model 2); Marchini's table 17 (4 of 8); either table read as relative risks 18, and Marchini's model 2 at MAF 0.05 to 0.2 cannot reach lambda = 0.5 as relative risks.

sim_assumptions.what: The marginal effect lambda is the odds ratio of the marginal penetrances of the heterozygote and the wild-type homozygote, minus 1 (Zhang and Liu 2007; epiMODE Text S1); prevalence 0.1 for every model (the paper)
sim_assumptions.sensitivity: Prevalence 0.01 for model 2 (epiMODE's setting) puts 15 or 18 of the 24 chi-squared bars within Monte Carlo error instead of 21 (model_variants.json).

sim_assumptions.what: LD between a disease locus and its marker: the marker has the locus's minor allele frequency and each marker allele follows the locus allele on its haplotype with correlation r = sqrt(r2) (epiMODE Text S1); null markers have MAF from U(0, 0.5) (the paper); the two disease markers sit at random columns
sim_assumptions.sensitivity: Using 0.7 as r instead of r2 lowers model 3 at MAF 0.5 to 9% chi-squared power against the published 38% (model_variants.json, epimode_odds_r2_as_r: 19 of 24 bars within Monte Carlo error).

sim_assumptions.what: A disease marker counts as identified when it is in any reported test; power is the share of 100 data sets where both are
sim_assumptions.sensitivity: summary.json gives epiForest's power when both markers must be in one reported test (epiforest_joint) or reported singly (epiforest_one_way).

ef_assumptions.what: ntree = 500 (randomForest's default) for the first forest and every SWSFS forest; the paper gives ntree only for the AMD forests (10^6)
ef_assumptions.sensitivity: With 2000 trees SWSFS keeps still fewer SNPs on the data sets we tried (output/checks/swsfs_variants.json).

ef_assumptions.what: mtry = floor(sqrt(number of SNPs in the forest)), randomForest's default (the paper prints the default garbled)
ef_assumptions.sensitivity: With mtry fixed at 31 for every SWSFS forest: output/checks/swsfs_variants.json.

ef_assumptions.what: B statistic with pseudo-counts 0.5 and P0 in the denominator (the paper prints P1/P1); 2B minus a shift from Stirling's expansion is chi-squared with 3^k - 1 degrees of freedom (3^k - 3^t conditional); the conditional B tests the other markers with the reported ones keeping their association
ef_assumptions.sensitivity: On null data the shifted statistic has the right mean and tail for one- and two-way tests and is conservative for three-way tests (check.bstat_null).

ef_assumptions.what: Bonferroni over all L = 1000 markers (L, L(L-1)/2, L(L-1)(L-2)/6), as the paper says
ef_assumptions.sensitivity: summary.json, epiforest_bonf_candidates: Bonferroni over the candidates instead.

lr_assumptions.what: Stepwise logistic regression: the full model with one parameter per observed genotype combination (likelihood-ratio test against the null model); 100 SNPs (10%) kept by their single-locus test; single-locus results adjusted by L, stage-2 results by the number of stage-2 tests of each order (Marchini et al.'s two-stage strategy); a disease marker found in any significant test
lr_assumptions.sensitivity: summary.json: lr_bonf_all adjusts stage 2 by L(L-1)/2 and L(L-1)(L-2)/6; lr_single_only counts single-locus tests only.

render_assumptions.what: Drawn with base R at 12 x 6 in, 200 px per inch (the published 2400 x 1200 px), margins from the published frames; font Liberation Sans (Helvetica metrics); text sizes and offsets matched to the published glyphs. Only ink inside the frames is scored, so the text settings do not change the score

amd_cause.summary: The AMD genotypes (Klein et al. 2005, Affymetrix 100K, 96 cases and 50 controls) came from J. Hoh and were never deposited; the AREDS scan in dbGaP (phs000001) has controlled access, and whether it holds the same 146 people is unverified.
